subject.title: Generate secretref reference docs from secret target registry metadata

question: Which open SecretRef docs-generation PR should be the canonical implementation path for this issue?
rationale: Current main still has the reported generated-doc gap, while two open conflicting PRs attempt overlapping fixes with different proof and implementation quality signals.

options.title: Refresh the stronger proven PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89142 as the canonical path if maintainers are comfortable adopting that branch after conflict resolution and fresh proof.

options.title: Repair the same-author PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/91612 if maintainers prefer the issue author's smaller branch after it resolves the proof, formatter, and conflict concerns.

options.title: Request a fresh replacement
options.body: Ask for one narrow replacement PR if neither overlapping branch is worth adopting.

recommendation.title: Refresh the stronger proven PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89142 as the canonical path if maintainers are comfortable adopting that branch after conflict resolution and fresh proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged the original SecretRef coverage PR and has recent adjacent matrix-docs history, making him the best available routing owner for the implementation-path choice.
